## Purpose of this Part

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > Purpose of this Part] 20.1 The purpose of this Part is to enable counterclaims and other additional claims to be managed in the most convenient and effective manner.

## Scope and interpretation

## 20.2

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.2] (1) This Part applies to –

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.2] (a) a counterclaim by a defendant against the claimant or against the claimant and some other person;

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.2] (b) an additional claim by a defendant against any person (whether or not already a party) for contribution or indemnity or some other remedy; and

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.2] (c) where an additional claim has been made against a person who is not already a party, any additional claim made by that person against any other person (whether or not already a party).

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.2] (2) In these Rules –

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.2] (a) ‘additional claim’ means any claim other than the claim by the claimant against the defendant; and

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.2] (b) unless the context requires otherwise, references to a claimant or defendant include a party bringing or defending an additional claim.

## Application of these Rules to additional claims

## 20.3

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.3] (1) An additional claim shall be treated as if it were a claim for the purposes of these Rules, except as provided by this Part.

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.3] (2) The following rules do not apply to additional claims –

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.3] (a) rules 7.5 and 7.6 (time within which a claim form may be served);

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.3] (b) rule 16.3(5) (statement of value where claim to be issued in the High Court); and

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.3] (c) Part 26 (case management – preliminary stage).

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.3] (3) Part 12 (default judgment) applies to a counterclaim but not to other additional claims.

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.3] (4) Part 14 (admissions) applies to a counterclaim, but only rules 14.2(1), (4) and (5) and 14.4(1) apply to other additional claims.

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.3] (Rule 12.3(2) sets out how to obtain judgment in default of defence for a counterclaim against the claimant, and rule 20.11 makes special provision for default judgment for some additional claims).

## Defendant’s counterclaim against the claimant

## 20.4

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.4] (1) A defendant may make a counterclaim against a claimant by filing particulars of the counterclaim.

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.4] (2) A defendant may make a counterclaim against a claimant –

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.4] (a) without the court’s permission if the defendant files the counterclaim with the defence; or

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.4] (b) at any other time with the court’s permission.

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.4] (Part 15 makes provision for a defence to a claim and applies to a defence to a counterclaim by virtue of rule 20.3).

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.4] (3) Part 10 (acknowledgment of service) does not apply to a claimant who wishes to defend a counterclaim.

## Counterclaim against a person other than the claimant

## 20.5

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.5] (1) Subject to rule 20.7, a defendant who wishes to counterclaim against a person other than the claimant must apply to the court for an order that that person be added as an additional party.

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.5] (2) An application for an order under paragraph (1) may be made without notice unless the court directs otherwise.

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.5] (3) Where the court makes an order under paragraph (1), it will give directions as to the management of the case.

## Defendant’s additional claim for contribution or indemnity from another party

## 20.6

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.6] (1) A defendant who has filed an acknowledgment of service or a defence may make an additional claim for contribution or indemnity against a person who is already a party to the proceedings by filing and serving on that party a notice containing a statement of the nature and grounds of the additional claim.

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.6] (2) A defendant may file and serve a notice under this rule –

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.6] (a) without the court’s permission, if the defendant files and serves it –

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.6] (i) with the defence; or

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.6] (ii) if their additional claim for contribution or indemnity is against a party added to the claim later, within 28 days after that party files their defence; or

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.6] (b) at any other time with the court’s permission.

## Procedure for making any other additional claim

## 20.7

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.7] (1) This rule applies to any additional claim except –

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.7] (a) a counterclaim only against an existing party; and

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.7] (b) a claim for contribution or indemnity made in accordance with rule 20.6.

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.7] (2) An additional claim is made when the court issues the appropriate claim form.

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.7] (Rule 7.2(2) provides that a claim form is issued on the date entered on the form by the court)

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.7] (3) A defendant may make an additional claim –

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.7] (a) without the court’s permission if the additional claim is issued before or at the same time as they file their defence;

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.7] (b) at any other time with the court’s permission.

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.7] (Rule 15.4 sets out the period for filing a defence).

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.7] (4) Particulars of an additional claim must be contained in or served with the additional claim.

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.7] (5) An application for permission to make an additional claim may be made without notice, unless the court directs otherwise.

## Service of claim form

## 20.8

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.8] (1) Where an additional claim may be made without the court’s permission, any claim form must –

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.8] (a) in the case of a counterclaim against an additional party only, be served on every other party when a copy of the defence is served;

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.8] (b) in the case of any other additional claim, be served on the person against whom it is made within 14 days after the date on which the additional claim is issued by the court.

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.8] (2) Paragraph (1) does not apply to a claim for contribution or indemnity made in accordance with rule 20.6.

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.8] (3) Where the court gives permission to make an additional claim it will at the same time give directions as to its service.

## Matters relevant to question of whether an additional claim should be separate from the claim

## 20.9

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.9] (1) This rule applies where the court is considering whether to –

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.9] (a) permit an additional claim to be made;

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.9] (b) dismiss an additional claim; or

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.9] (c) require an additional claim to be dealt with separately from the claim by the claimant against the defendant.

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.9] (Rule 3.1(2)(e) and (j) deal respectively with the court’s power to order that part of proceedings be dealt with as separate proceedings and to decide the order in which issues are to be tried).

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.9] (2) The matters which the court may consider include –

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.9] (a) the connection between the additional claim and the claim made by the claimant against the defendant;

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.9] (b) whether the additional claimant is seeking substantially the same remedy which some other party is claiming from them; and

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.9] (c) whether the additional claimant wants the court to decide any question connected with the subject matter of the proceedings –

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.9] (i) not only between existing parties but also between existing parties and a person not already a party; or

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.9] (ii) against an existing party not only in a capacity in which they are already a party but also in some further capacity.

## Effect of service of an additional claim

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > Effect of service of an additional claim] 20.10 A person on whom an additional claim is served becomes a party to the proceedings if they are not a party already.

## 20.11

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.11] (1) This rule applies if –

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.11] (a) the additional claim is not –

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.11] (i) a counterclaim; or

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.11] (ii) a claim by a defendant for contribution or indemnity against another defendant under rule 20.6; and

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.11] (b) the party against whom an additional claim is made fails to file an acknowledgment of service or defence in respect of the additional claim.

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.11] (2) The party against whom the additional claim is made –

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.11] (a) is deemed to admit the additional claim, and is bound by any judgment or decision in the proceedings as far as it is relevant to any matter arising in the additional claim;

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.11] (b) subject to paragraph (3), if default judgment under Part 12 is given against the additional claimant, the additional claimant may obtain judgment in respect of the additional claim by filing a request in the relevant practice form.

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.11] (3) An additional claimant may not enter judgment under paragraph (2)(b) without the court’s permission if –

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.11] (a) they have not satisfied the default judgment which has been given against them; or

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.11] (b) they wish to obtain judgment for any remedy other than a contribution or indemnity.

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.11] (4) An application for the court’s permission under paragraph (3) may be made without notice unless the court directs otherwise.

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.11] (5) The court may at any time set aside or vary a judgment entered under paragraph (2)(b).

## Procedural steps on service of an additional claim form on a non-party

## 20.12

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.12] (1) Where an additional claim form is served on a person who is not already a party it must be accompanied by –

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.12] (a) a form for defending the claim;

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.12] (b) a form for admitting the claim;

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.12] (c) a form for acknowledging service; and

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.12] (d) a copy of –

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.12] (i) every statement of case which has already been served in the proceedings; and

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.12] (ii) such other documents as the court may direct.

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.12] (2) A copy of the additional claim form must be served on every existing party.

## Case management where a defence to an additional claim is filed

## 20.13

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.13] (1) Where a defence is filed to an additional claim the court must consider the future conduct of the proceedings and give appropriate directions.

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.13] (2) In giving directions under paragraph (1) the court must ensure that, so far as practicable, the original claim and all additional claims are managed together.

[PART 20 – COUNTERCLAIMS AND OTHER ADDITIONAL CLAIMS > 20.13] (Part 66 contains provisions about counterclaims and other additional claims in relation to proceedings by or against the Crown.)
